newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel stocks bring down Mauritius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hotel stocks bring down Mauritius bourse.

text.p: Falling shares in the hotel sector and political uncertainty brought down the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index, Semdex, which eased by 1.75 points on Wednesday to 385.97, bourse officials said.
The volume traded amounted to 21.35 million rupees on 941,625 shares from 3.65 million rupees on 184,339 shares on Monday.
"Political uncertainty is prevailing on the stock market after the Labour-MMM government alliance broke up," a broker said. He added the trend would continue until a cabinet reshuffle.

Hotel-based Sun Resorts lost 10 cents to 49.90 rupees on 8,870 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) fell 30 cents to 38.00 rupees on 151,015 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) was 30 cents lower to 49.70 and was unquoted.
Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was stable at 90.00 rupees on 66,926 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) gained 10 cents to 12.00 rupees on 12,500 shares.
Industry stocks Mauritius Breweries Ltd MALL.MZ (MBL) eased 1.00 rupee to 154.00 rupees on 185 shares and Mauritius Oil Refineries (MOR) lost 20 cents to 11.50 rupees on 78,858 shares.
In the commerce sector, conglomerate Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was 40 cents lower to 16.20 rupees on 1,334 shares and Rogers was unchanged to 100.00 rupees on 9 shares.

Sugar-based Harel Freres fell 1.00 rupee to 55.00 rupees on 20,000 shares, Mon Desert Alma (MDA) (P) lost 1.50 rupee to 83.50 rupees on 407 shares, Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) was stable at 40.00 rupees on 2,171 shares and Savannah (O) was 5.00 rupees lower to 138.00 rupees on 2,217 shares.
Air Mauritius was unchanged at 38.40 rupees on 20,020 shares.
